summary: Quiet work renewals update only lease timestamps instead of maintaining unchanged state indexes

replay.detail: Renewal claims, replicated anchor cadence and local lease replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, retention policies or SQLite durability settings change.

rules.detail: Existing actor, incarnation and live-lease checks still fence every renewal. Only a renewal with no replicated publication uses the lease-only UPDATE.

compatibility.detail: Requests, receipts, lease expiry and responses are unchanged. Published renewals and other work actions retain the full state update.

downtime.detail: The lower-write path takes effect when the daemon binary is updated; it does not modify or relocate an existing database.

manual.detail: No vacuum, checkpoint, state-directory migration or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: SQLite transactions and FULL WAL durability are unchanged. Idempotent retries retain their existing receipts.
